none: PAS HESH-6ABE93: Roman Coin: Nummus SPES REIPUBLIAE
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn copper alloy nummi of the House Constantine - reverse type SALVS REIPVBLICAE (AD 324-330). Mint - Trier - probably. Reece Period: 16. Obverse description: Bust of a male figure, diadem crown, draped, right. Obverse inscription: _AON_. Reverse description: Salus in toga holding infant. Reverse inscription: // TRP. Die axis measurement: 6 o'clock. Weight: 0.9g. Diameter: 13.1mm
